privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice says what Fat Cat Fit collects about you, why, for how long, and what you can do with it.

purpose.title: 1. Why we collect it
paragraphs: To make the app work: sign you in, let you log workouts, and show your own progress.
We don't sell data, use it for ads or marketing, or pass it to anyone except the providers in section 4. Friends in the group cannot see your data.

Weight, height and workouts are health data, which is sensitive data. We collect and use it only with your explicit consent (section 26 of Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act). Account data (email and sign-in data) is kept to provide the service you asked for (section 24(3)), including the time before you tap agree.

required.title: 2. Do you have to give it
paragraphs: No law requires you to give this data; you give it voluntarily. Some of it is needed to use the app:
items: Needed: email (to confirm who you are when you sign in)
Needed: weight, height, birth year and your first workout place (for calculations and defaults)
Optional: goals and experience
Minimum age: the app is not open to anyone under 20
Without the needed data you can't sign up or use the app.

collected.title: 3. What we store, and for how long
items: Account: email and name, plus your Google account ID (only with Google sign-in, the name and ID come from your Google account) — kept until you delete your account · we do not store your profile picture, and we do not keep your IP address or browser details with your account

Health data (sensitive): weight, height and birth year from the questionnaire, workout places, goals, experience, and the workout history you'll log in later versions — kept until you delete your account
Settings: units, language, theme, rest time — kept until you delete your account
Consent record: time, notice version and language — kept until you delete your account
Sign-in: the sign-in in your browser lasts 90 days
On your own device: language, theme, and a mark that you've signed in before — stays in your browser, sent nowhere
collected.safetyTitle: Security data (not tied to your account) and how long it stays:
safety: Request limiting: IP address and the path requested, deleted automatically within about 2 days
6-digit sign-in code: stored in a form that can't be reversed, expires in 10 minutes, deleted within about 1 day
Code request counter: stored in a form that can't be reversed, deleted within about 3 days

Logs of the hosting provider Vercel: path, URL query string, IP address, user agent and system messages, shown in the app's admin view for at most 1 hour; what Vercel keeps itself follows Vercel's own policy
The code email: sent from the app's Gmail account, and Gmail keeps a copy in its Sent folder until the admin deletes it (the admin clears it from time to time)

recipients.title: 4. Who receives it, and is it sent abroad
paragraphs: Providers that help the app run. All operate outside Thailand, so data is sent to and processed abroad (section 28):
items: Neon: stores the database, in Singapore (the data in section 3 lives here)
Vercel: hosts the app and receives your requests; the app servers are in Singapore, and the provider may process data in the United States and other countries where it operates

Google: operates in many countries worldwide — if you choose Google sign-in, Google knows you use this app · and the app's Gmail account sends you the code email, so it sees the destination address and the code in that message
No other recipients
recipients.after: The destination countries may have personal data protection standards different from Thailand's.

controller.title: 5. Who is the data controller
controller.notSet: The data controller's name and contact are not set up yet

rights.title: 6. Your rights
items: Ask for access to, and a copy of, your data
Ask us to correct your data
Erase your data: delete your account yourself, any time, at Me › Delete account
Withdraw consent (see section 8)
Ask for your data as a file: the export button will arrive in a later version; until then ask through the contact in section 5
Object to, or ask us to restrict, the use of your data
Complain to the Personal Data Protection Committee Office if you think we broke the law

backup.title: 7. Backups
paragraphs: When you delete your account your data leaves the app right away, but the database provider may be able to restore it for up to 6 hours (and up to 7 days if the whole system is deleted), after which it disappears on its own. We don't use data from that period for anything else.

withdraw.title: 8. Withdrawing consent
paragraphs: You can withdraw consent any time by deleting your account (Me › Delete account). After that your data is erased and the app can no longer be used, because it needs health data to work. There is no partial withdrawal. Withdrawing doesn't affect what was done before.
If this notice changes, we'll ask you to agree again before you keep using the app.
